Resolves #21244

The streamed-batches test in `IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` no longer races the grid's load-time scroll reset. `store.load()` opens the stream with an ordinary load, so each grid body dispatches `scrollTo(top)` after `grid.Body#onStoreLoad`'s 50 ms. The test wheeled about 5 ms after that load, and on a slow runner the reset landed after the wheel: `scrollTop` 0 on e2e-engine 11/14, on #21223 and #21235. The worker now records the view's scroll-to-top dispatches. The test awaits the initial ones before the first batch, and asserts that neither a streamed batch nor the stream's end dispatches another.

Evidence: L2 (a probe copy of the spec in local headless Chrome, with the reset forced 500 ms late; it reads the store from the worker because my seat's Neural Link bridge was unavailable) → L2 required (a test-only race; the ACs name the forced-delay and throttle runs). The spec itself runs in CI's e2e-engine tier.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 with the reset delayed 500 ms, red without the guard and green with it | outside CI: the probe failed 3/3 with `Received: 0` without the guard and passed 3/3 with it |
| AC-2 green unthrottled and under 6× CPU throttle | outside CI: the probe passed 3/3 at each |
| AC-3 streamed batches assert that no further scroll-to-top is dispatched | CI-covered: `resetCount()` equals the initial count after each batch and at the stream's end |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. Measured before the fix: load t=285 (count 0) · first batch t=290 (count 200, `postChunkLoad`) · three resets t=338. The first batch is `postChunkLoad`, so the only resets come from the stream's opening load.

## Test Evidence
- The probe was the committed spec with three changes: the store read from the worker, a 500 ms delay knob on the dispatch, and a switch for the guard. Its runs are in the AC rows. I deleted it before the commit.
- The committed spec needs the Neural Link bridge, which timed out locally (`waitForSession`), so CI provides the spec's own run.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here.
